# axm mcps list

List installed MCP servers

## When to use

List installed MCP servers

## Usage

```bash
axm mcps list [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

| Name      | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                  |
| --------- | ------ | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope` | choice | No       | List MCP servers from project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**See installed MCP servers**

```bash
axm mcps list
```

**Check user-level MCP servers**

```bash
axm mcps list --scope user
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
